name: [4th Anniversary] My Hello Kitty Cafe(Build)
desc:
Welcome to 《My Hello Kitty Cafe》!
You will run the world-famous Hello Kitty-themed café in your town.
Invite the famous Sanrio® characters  to help you run the café.
Make various delicious drinks and sweets, attract multiple customers, and earn the honor of a five-star café!

🚨Update Log🚨
The new Kuromi event is now LIVE! 💜
Explore the updated Kuromi Mansion Mini Game, complete special event missions, and earn the Kuromi Mini Stage reward!
